Separate T-SQL/CLR cases for DML, database DDL, server DDL and logon; native DML case. CLR excludes ENCRYPTION. OWNER allowed only DML; database DDL uses user, server DDL/logon login. Body/event inputs opaque. Views require INSTEAD OF. WITH APPEND omitted: official applicability says SQL Server 2008/2008 R2 only. ATOMIC requires LANGUAGE and TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL exactly once each; option list preserves ordering but consumer must enforce cardinality.
